summary: Five-day modelling arc holds: D1 question → D2 data → D3 predict → D4 reflect/refine → D5 capstone, each lesson cross-referencing prior day with cited research (English 2010, CGI, Lehrer & Schauble, Thompson & Saldanha). Mayor Mira and Town Tom anchor every minds_on/consolidation with consistent refrains; vocabulary introduces with its skill and threads forward. Capstone integrates the cycle via 5-step template plus Part 6 transfer probe rather than a 4-station Day-mirror, holding at 3 — the one permitted arc-level 3.
